rollback: Revert the squash-merge commit for live-studio-controls on a repair branch.
Run the existing API/frontend CI and gauntlet to prove the restored state.
Promote or redeploy the prior known-good frontend from baseline main if the new Vercel deployment is unhealthy.
acceptance: Agent command uses the Studio API in live mode.
Calendar resolves a TryPost account before scheduling.
Scheduling requires exact content, future time, selected account, format, and explicit human approval.
No database or secret mutation is introduced.
